body: Removed the introductory Focus copy and counters. Preserved attention reasons on pinned cards and made In motion use bounded active-card reads without loading a milestone collection. The floating Add card button opens the existing centered autosave editor. Local gate, five relevant release browser suites and broad HTTPS smoke passed. Updated the manual runtime; both projects validate and all source versions and the focus list were preserved. Evidence: progress/2026-09-22-focus-layout.md.

metadata.summary: Focus now shows pinned cards, attention and active work without duplicate rows; Add card floats at the lower right.
